description: Detect and manipulate serialized objects in cookies. Analyzes cookie values for serialization patterns (PHP serialize, Java, .NET ViewState, base64-encoded JSON). If a serialized format is detected, attempts privilege escalation by modifying fields (admin=1, role=admin). Returns: {detection: {format, decoded, fields}, manipulation_results: [...]}. Side effects: Sends requests with modified cookies. May escalate privileges if successful.

auth_cookie.description: Additional auth cookies to send, e.g. 'session=abc123'

cookie_name.description: Cookie name that may contain serialized data, e.g. 'session', 'user', 'data'

cookie_value.description: Current cookie value to analyze. If not provided, fetches from the target URL

url.description: Target URL to test, e.g. https://target/my-account

name: deserialization_test
